info.name: BuildFlow API
info.description:
BuildFlow /api/v1 endpoints. Run requests top to bottom inside a folder — several requests auto-fill the collection variables (token, project_id, task_id, supervisor_id) used by the ones after them, via each request's Tests tab script.

Start order: Auth > Login, then Projects > List Assigned Projects, then anything in Tasks.

request.description: All workers (role is case-insensitive: worker, Worker or WORKER). Use the id as worker_id for Assign Worker.

request.description:
OWNER or SUPERVISOR only, on a project they are assigned to. A Worker token gets 403.

Optional worker_id assigns the task to a worker on the project right away (they get notified). Remove it to create the task unassigned.
OWNER or SUPERVISOR only. multipart/form-data: creates the task, assigns the worker and uploads up to 10 files in one call. Pick the files in each attachments[] row.
OWNER or SUPERVISOR only. Send only the fields to change. worker_id reassigns the worker; send it as null to unassign. To add files, switch to form-data and add attachments[] rows.
OWNER or SUPERVISOR only. Deletes the task and its attachment files. Returns 422 if the task already has work submissions.

query.description: Task title, task code or project location

request.description: Returns only tasks assigned to the logged-in user as worker (assign via Tasks > Assign Worker). Use a WORKER token; Owner and Supervisor tokens always get an empty list.

OWNER or SUPERVISOR only. One file as `file` (pdf/jpg/jpeg/png/doc/docx, max 10MB). In Postman, set the row type to File and pick a file. If you get "failed to upload", the file is bigger than the server PHP upload_max_filesize.
OWNER or SUPERVISOR only. Up to 10 files as files[] (pdf/jpg/jpeg/png/doc/docx, max 10MB each). Returns data as an array.

exec: if (pm.response.code === 200) { const j = pm.response.json(); if (j.data.length) { pm.collectionVariables.set('material_id', j.data[0].id); } }
